description: This file defines the DirectEditingRepository class responsible for managing direct editing URLs for notes in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It interacts with server settings, file APIs, and handles asynchronous network calls using RxJava.

classes.name: DirectEditingRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling direct editing URL retrieval for notes, utilizing server settings and file API calls.

methods.name: getNotesPath
methods.description: Retrieves the notes path from server settings for a given account asynchronously.

methods.name: getDirectEditingUrl
methods.description: Fetches the direct editing URL for a specific note and account, returning an RxJava Single.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the DirectEditingRepository instance, ensuring a single instance per application context.
